name: Party Identification 117
definition: Choice of identification of a party. The party can be identified by providing a BIC or a proprietary code.|Optionally, the client account number can also be provided.

AnyBIC.name: Any BIC
AnyBIC.definition: Code allocated to a financial or non-financial institution by the ISO 9362 Registration Authority, as described in ISO 9362 "Banking - Banking telecommunication messages - Business identifier code (BIC)".

ProprietaryIdentification.name: Proprietary Identification
ProprietaryIdentification.definition: Unique and unambiguous identifier, as assigned to a financial institution using a proprietary identification scheme.

NameAndAddress.name: Name And Address
NameAndAddress.definition: Identification of a party with its name and address in free text.
